conventions.units: Models with scale_units 'hex' (default): 1.0 = one hex flat-to-flat; multiply by your hex width. Models with scale_units 'm' (kind building and lm_*_nb): 1.0 = one metre at real size, so one metres->world factor keeps every building consistent.
conventions.real_m: Approximate real-world size in metres (w longest horizontal, d other horizontal, h height); null for hex dioramas. Use real_m.h / normalised.height to convert any model to metres.
conventions.ground_y: Tiles only: height of the top of the hex slab in model units; sink the model by ground_y so the slab top is flush with the terrain. *_noplinth variants have the slab cut away.
conventions.up: +Y up; lowest point at y=0; footprint centred on the origin.
conventions.tiles: Tile models carry a thin pointy-top hex slab (corners on +-Z) exactly 1.0 flat-to-flat.
conventions.facing: Units/props face roughly +Z (towards a default Civ-style camera).
conventions.suggested_scale: Extra multiplier on top of the hex width (1.0 = as authored).
conventions.generator: Which image-to-3D model produced the GLB; trellis ones should be regenerated with hunyuan-3d-3.1 when it has capacity.
